# Tracking Guru

> Google Ads and Meta Ads management with full online and offline
> conversion tracking, for local service businesses and B2B companies in
> the United Kingdom, United States, and Canada.

## What we do

Tracking Guru sets up and manages Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, and
builds the conversion tracking behind them: Google tag and GA4 event
tracking, Enhanced Conversions for Leads, Meta Pixel and Conversions API
with event deduplication, server-side tagging (server-side GTM, typically
hosted on Stape.io), and offline conversion imports that connect a
CRM-closed deal back to the ad click that originally drove it.

## Who we serve

Local service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, home services) and B2B
companies (professional and managed services), plus law firms and medical
aesthetics practices, operating in the UK, US, and Canada.
